baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction links ذَهَبَ, إِلَى أَهْلِهِ, and the circumstantial يَتَمَطَّى.
baseline_models.mechanism: Passing away from the prior scene toward the people of closest belonging while bodily extending himself turns a trip home into self-display before an intimate audience.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing supply the directed departure that carries the performance into another social space.
People bound by closeness and belonging make the destination an intimate audience rather than a bare location.
Swaggering self-extension supplies the inflated bodily manner that converts movement into display.

changed_reading.before: He simply went home while swaggering.
changed_reading.after: He carries an enlarged posture into the circle of belonging most able to recognize and reinforce his self-presentation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The directional phrase إِلَى أَهْلِهِ places the extended gait inside a destination marked by familiarity.
baseline_models.mechanism: A route or manner leads into familiar habitation, where bodily extension reads as taking up space within a secure and accustomed domain.

activation_trace.role: The way, place, or manner image lets the going register as entry into a chosen mode and domain.
Familiar habitation supplies the spatial and affective security into which he moves.
Stretching and extension picture the body expanding once it enters familiar territory.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a point-to-point return to a household.
changed_reading.after: The return is an expansion into familiar territory, with home functioning as the domain in which his posture can occupy space confidently.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The manner verb يَتَمَطَّى can lengthen the event denoted by ذَهَبَ rather than merely decorate its endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinary going is stretched into extended travel, so the family destination terminates a sustained procession rather than an instantaneous exit.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing provide the base motion whose duration can be expanded.
The close group supplies the social endpoint toward which the extended movement proceeds.
Extended going or travel makes the gait a prolonged procession rather than a static pose.

changed_reading.before: Swaggering is a pose incidental to arriving home.
changed_reading.after: The whole journey toward his people is drawn out as a performed procession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and deliberate turning away immediately feed into going and swaggering, converting an inward or propositional refusal into a bodily and social enactment.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing carry the preceding refusal away from its encounter and toward a new audience.
Swaggering self-extension gives the refusal a visible bodily form.
Attributing the message to falsehood supplies the explicit act of repudiation that the gait continues.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the directional break that becomes physical departure.

structural_cues: 75:31-33 moves from paired negations through وَلَٰكِن to denial and turning away, then uses ثُمَّ to introduce the focus gait.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, turning away, subsequent going, and swagger; I infer a causal continuation from refused truth to performed defiance, while a merely chronological departure remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a proud departure after an unspecified failure.
changed_reading.after: The swaggering homeward walk is the public, bodily afterlife of his denial and turning away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier removal of every escape and refuge, followed by settlement with the Lord, makes movement toward familiar habitation look like a temporary substitute refuge that cannot be the final destination.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing establish the apparent route away from exposure.
Familiar habitation makes the household a plausible zone of ease and shelter.
Flight and escape establish the surah's explicit search for a way out.
The refuge image supplies precisely what the sequence denies to the escaping person.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the authority at the unavoidable destination.
Fixity and settlement supply the final endpoint against which the household stop is measured.

structural_cues: 75:10 asks where flight is, 75:11 denies refuge, and 75:12 names settlement with the Lord; 75:33 later names family as a chosen destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an escaping human, no refuge, final settlement, and a later move into familiar habitation; I infer that the household is being used as a felt shelter, while it may remain only a neutral destination in the local syntax.

changed_reading.before: He returns securely to his familiar household.
changed_reading.after: He moves as though familiarity could shelter him, but the surah has already displaced that local home with an unavoidable settlement under lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love fastens desire to what is brought forward, abandonment removes what comes later, and the focus then gives that temporal preference a concrete destination in familiar people and an expansive present-tense gait.

activation_trace.role: Familiar habitation embodies the near, available sphere into which preference retreats.
Swaggering self-extension displays satisfaction within that immediate sphere.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the affective attachment driving the choice.
Hastening and bringing forward define the chosen temporal horizon as immediate.
Leaving something supplies the active abandonment paired with the immediate attachment.
What comes after supplies the deferred horizon being left behind.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 explicitly opposes loving the immediate to leaving the later; the focus gives the preferred near world a household destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies love of the immediate, abandonment of the later, familiar habitation, and swagger; I infer that the homeward gait enacts that preference, while the temporal contrast could remain a general diagnosis rather than a comment on this destination.

changed_reading.before: He goes to his family after rejecting the demand placed on him.
changed_reading.after: He visibly settles his desire in the familiar and immediately available world, strutting inside the very preference for the near over the later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The swaggering body is counter-read as dispersed hard structure that can be gathered, restored to integrity, and specified down to its extremities; bodily self-enlargement therefore displays material that is fully reconstructible.

activation_trace.role: Swaggering self-extension makes bodily form the vehicle of pride.
Joining dispersed parts into one supplies the reversal of bodily dispersal.
Hard bone supplies the material substrate beneath the displayed posture.
Integrity and completion supply the restoration of form rather than a rough reassembly.
The body's extremities supply the fine-grained limit of reconstructive control.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 answers the human calculation with a sequence from gathered bones to restored fingertips, while 75:33 foregrounds that human's bodily manner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily swagger and exact reassembly; I infer an ironic counter-image in which the displayed body is owned at the level of its parts, while the reassembly passage can function only as proof of resurrection.

changed_reading.before: His extended posture communicates bodily command and importance.
changed_reading.after: The swagger ironically parades a body whose hard frame and smallest extremities can be dispersed and precisely remade.

context_deltas.mechanism: Swaggering self-extension acts as a voluntary self-raising posture under the surah's announced rising, turning his lifted bearing into a small and false anticipation of the rising he does not control.

activation_trace.role: Swaggering self-extension supplies the chosen elevation of bodily bearing.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour supply the involuntary, encompassing counter-rising.

structural_cues: The surah opens by naming the Day of Rising and later repeats the question about that day before presenting the focus posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily self-extension and eschatological rising; I infer a posture-level irony between chosen self-elevation and compelled rising, while the shared vertical image may remain only analogical.

changed_reading.before: He raises his bearing to look important while walking.
changed_reading.after: His self-raised gait becomes a miniature counterfeit of the greater rising that will remove his control over posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Chosen extended travel toward family is inverted by separation, bodily entanglement, and driving toward the Lord: the same person moves first as agent and finally as one conveyed.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing supply the voluntary motion that the counter-sequence reverses.
Extended going supplies a smooth, self-directed journey.
Separation and scattering break the bonds toward which the focus traveler presently heads.
Wrapping one thing around another replaces extended ease with bodily entanglement.
Driving and herding supply movement imposed from outside rather than self-directed travel.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the destination and the authority governing the compelled movement.

structural_cues: 75:28-30 sequences separation, entwined legs, and the drive toward the Lord before 75:31-33 recalls the person's chosen acts and gait.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed movement scenes; I infer that the earlier compelled conveyance retrospectively strips autonomy from the later narrated swagger, while the scenes may remain temporally distinct description and moral retrospect.

changed_reading.before: He controls his route, pace, body, and destination as he goes to his people.
changed_reading.after: His confident self-propelled journey is shadowed by a counterjourney in which bonds separate, legs entangle, and he is driven toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus movement seems to create distance, but the immediately repeated root images of proximity, succession, and deservingness make consequence close the gap and follow act after act.

activation_trace.role: Going away supplies the apparent increase in distance from the rejected demand.
The close household supplies the destination in which he appears to have arrived safely.
Nearness without an interval supplies consequence that remains close despite his departure.
One thing following another supplies the repeated sequence of consequence after conduct.
Priority and deservingness supply the evaluative fit between his conduct and what follows.

structural_cues: 75:34-35 follows the focus with four repetitions of أَوْلَىٰ, and 75:35 repeats ثُمَّ from the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure followed immediately by repeated nearness, succession, and deservingness images; I infer consequence pursuing and fitting him, while أَوْلَىٰ can remain a threat formula without literal spatial pursuit.

changed_reading.before: He exits into the safety of family and leaves the confrontation behind.
changed_reading.after: His departure cannot open protective distance: deserved consequence is already near and follows in repeated succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's extended going looks like free self-direction, but the next question denies that the human will simply be left in his present state or allowed an unbounded travel-like motion.

activation_trace.role: Extended going or travel supplies the apparent freedom to continue on one's own course.
Leaving a thing on its existing state supplies the condition explicitly put in question.
The sadu image in travel and hand supplies a branch-level motion echo to the extended gait.

structural_cues: 75:36 immediately reopens أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ and asks whether the human will be left سُدًى after the focus departure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extended travel, leaving-on-state, and a travel-like sadu image; I infer a denial of autonomous roaming, while سُدًى may more generally denote neglect or purposelessness rather than a gait.

changed_reading.before: He chooses his route and proceeds as though nothing can interrupt it.
changed_reading.after: The strut becomes the visual form of imagined autonomy, immediately challenged by the question of whether he can be left to continue without purpose or claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The household-bearing identity before which he swells is itself downstream of apportioned semen, creation, and paired marriage; social belonging therefore cannot ground independent status.

activation_trace.role: Making a household through marriage supplies the generated social identity to which he returns.
Swaggering self-extension supplies the claim of status that the origin sequence undercuts.
Semen from which form is apportioned supplies the dependent material origin of the householder.
Bringing creation into being supplies an agency prior to his present social role.
The marriage pair supplies the relational basis from which a household is made.

structural_cues: 75:37-39 moves from emitted origin through creation to the male-female pair immediately after denying that the human is left without purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household-through-marriage, reproductive origin, creation, pairing, and swagger; I infer that derivative creaturely and social status exposes the pride as borrowed, while the closing sequence may primarily prove creative power.

changed_reading.before: He returns as an established householder whose people confirm his standing.
changed_reading.after: The identity he displays before his household is itself made, paired, and dependent, so the swagger magnifies a status he did not originate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because إِلَى أَهْلِهِ keeps ذَهَبَ in the ordinary going construction; it remains anchored because the focus root's dazzlement branch explicitly includes a flashing or stunned eye and 75:7 supplies that eye-state, so downstream prose should render it only as foreshadowing that overlays the literal departure, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذَهَبَ carries a branch image of dazzlement while يَتَمَطَّى preserves the overt confident gait.

activation_trace.role: Dazzlement or fright on seeing gold supplies a latent loss of visual composure inside the root of the literal going.
Swaggering self-extension preserves the surface scene of present composure and pride.
The staring or stunned eye supplies the contextual state that activates the distant focus branch.

changed_reading.before: His gait exhibits unbroken visual and bodily confidence.
changed_reading.after: The confident departure carries a faint root-level preview of the stunned gaze that will replace swagger with shock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the verbal syntax means going, not gold or gilding; it remains anchored in ذ ه ب and is activated by 75:22's explicit gold-purity branch, so prose should use the image only for the sheen or plating of social self-display and never lexicalize ذَهَبَ as gold.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of ذَهَبَ has gold and gilding branches, and the focus manner already marks conspicuous display.

activation_trace.role: Gilding supplies an outer prestigious coating as an image for performed status.
Swaggering self-extension gives that gilded image a bodily vehicle.
Gold's brightness and purity supply the contextual metallic sheen that activates the focus root's gilding branch.

changed_reading.before: He advertises importance through an inflated walk.
changed_reading.after: His family-facing display can be pictured as gilded status, an impressive outer coating set against the surah's other kind of radiance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The anatomical linkage is surprising and cross-domain, but it remains anchored in يَتَمَطَّى through its back and swagger branches and in 75:25 through the explicit back-breaking calamity image; downstream prose should present it as corporeal irony, not as a claim that the focus verb denotes a back.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَمَطَّى combines a back-related root image with swaggering bodily extension.

activation_trace.role: The back as a ridden or extended surface localizes the proud posture anatomically.
Swaggering self-extension makes that back the visible axis of pride.
A calamity that breaks the back supplies the threatened reversal of the extended posture.

changed_reading.before: The extended back is the stable axis of his swagger.
changed_reading.after: The very body-line he extends in pride is exposed to the surah's image of a calamity that breaks the back.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links separate roots and distant scenes, but the death branch literally pictures death as the going-away of force and life while the focus uses the going root; prose may carry it as a lexical foreshadowing of depletion, qualified as an echo rather than an alternate sense of ذَهَبَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذَهَبَ names the person's present going, which can echo the later branch image ذهاب القوة والحياة.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing supply the focus motion echoed inside the description of death.
The going-away of force and life turns ordinary departure into a faint preview of mortal depletion.

changed_reading.before: A living man simply goes from one place to another.
changed_reading.after: His ordinary going carries a distant echo of the more absolute going-away of force and life invoked at the surah's close.

strongest_changes: The family destination changed from secure homecoming into a temporary, failed refuge contrasted with settlement under the Lord.
The self-directed extended gait changed into the first half of an agency reversal completed by separation, entangled legs, and compelled driving.
The swagger changed from incidental manner into the bodily and social continuation of denial, turning away, and preference for the immediate.
The displayed body and householder status changed from grounds of confidence into reconstructible and created dependencies.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation built a counter-sequence around the focus: departure versus unavoidable settlement, self-extension versus rising and bodily entanglement, intimate belonging versus separation, and present social status versus created origin. Rare branch echoes also exposed dazzlement, gilding, the vulnerable back, and the going-away of life without displacing the ordinary syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: The false-refuge model depends on treating familiar habitation as felt shelter rather than only a destination.
The standing, dazzlement, gold, back-breaking, and death echoes are visibly anchored but may remain too analogical for unqualified prose.
The proximity and succession branches of أَوْلَىٰ may describe consequence closing in, or the repeated form may function primarily as a threat formula.
